protocol.purpose: held-out source safety signal diagnostic; not target transfer or online search

context.purpose: source-coordinate cross-fitting; same historical forest screening

original_protocol.purpose: historical expression screening; no development or final targets
original_protocol.teacher_scope: each source forest uses that source only; own source excluded from replay inputs
original_protocol.screening: source response R128 strictly higher, N128 and discovery AUC no lower than both controls; at least two positive historical lineages versus each control

context.fold_rule: five shuffled KFold splits, seed 1301; common coordinate indices for all sources
context.source_training_scope: each prediction excludes its entire coordinate fold; own system excluded from inputs
context.screening: source response R128 strictly higher, N128 and discovery AUC no lower than both controls; at least two positive historical lineages versus each control

protocol.normalization: unchanged ResponseArchive.auxiliary clearance and TTC transforms
protocol.screening: primary AP higher and AUC no lower than collision predictor in both scenarios; two positive source AP lineages in each scenario
